body_style: 2-door saloon, rear engine, front luggage bonnet

front.grille: none: the engine is at the rear, so the front panel is a plain painted face, 26 units wide by 8 units high at x 50 y 10..18, with only a small chrome trim strip across it at y 16
front.bumper: thin chrome blade 1.6 units high spanning the full 41 unit width at x 50 y 9.5, wrapping just round the front corners
extras: two round headlamps set low and wide in a flat, slightly raked front panel
bonnet lid for the front luggage compartment, its gap line at y 21-23 and a chrome handle at x 22 y 21.5
number plate below the bumper on the front panel at x 50 y 6.5
no radiator grille and no air intake vents on the nose

rear.taillamps: two small round lamps, radius 1.2 units, set 8 units apart in the rear panel at x -49.7 y 14.5
rear.bumper: thin chrome blade 1.6 units high at x -50 y 9.5, matching the front
extras: engine cover lid over the rear engine, gap line from x -46.5 y 21 up to x -31 y 25 (the base of the rear window)
five horizontal ventilation louvres on the engine cover lid side, x -45.5..-41.5 at y 23..26
chrome engine cover handle at x -34 y 24.5
number plate on the rear panel at x -49.8 y 6.5
fuel filler cap behind the rear side window at x -27 y 22

side_features: door glass band x -26..22 y 25.3..37 (big windows: the car is famous for its glass area)
chrome waist trim strip x -30..22 y 25.4
front luggage bonnet lid gap line x 22..47 y 23.5..24.6
engine cover lid gap line x -46.5..-31 y 21..25
side vent louvres on the engine cover x -45.5..-41.5 y 23..26
round steel wheels r 8.0 with small chrome nave plates, front arch opening centred x 28.6, rear arch opening centred x -28.6
special: rear-mounted engine with a front luggage bonnet (the boot is at the front, the engine lid at the rear)
engine cover lid with ventilation louvres over the rear engine
very large glass area for such a small car
narrow track and small 13 inch wheels, so the arches sit close under the body sides
notes: Estimate, not confirmed by a second source: height 1350, width 1448, tyre overall diameter 570 (a 13 inch wheel with a 5.20-13 crossply is about 565-575 mm across, so the wheel radius may be 30 mm out either way) and both tracks (1217 front, 1210 rear). Confident on length 3556 and wheelbase 2032 (80 inches). The two proportions that matter most for looking like a real Imp: (1) the very long roof with steeply raked windscreen in front of it and the near-vertical rear window behind it, over an engine cover that starts at x -46.5; (2) the bonnet line is low and level at y 23.2-24.6, so the front luggage bonnet lid reads short, and there is no radiator grille at the front because the engine is in the back. Sill line y 5.8 and the round arch tops at about y 17 are estimates from side photos. Ref photo file names could not be verified without web access, so the two links are the Wikipedia article and the Commons category for the model.
